remarks: Looking for a great home with lots of space? This Cape Cod home is located on a quiet street in the Bettswood area! This 4 bedroom 3 full bath home offers a large eat-in kitchen with tons on cabinets for storage and great counter space for prepping. Enjoy the spacious living room/dining room with hardwood floors and large windows offering beautiful natural light. Easy living on the main floor with 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths and washer/dryer. Upstairs you will find 2 large bedrooms and another full bath. On the lower level you have a paneled room/rec room, great storage and mini kitchenette. Outside you will find a lovely patio for barbequing or just relaxing. FULL HOUSE GENERATOR and fueled by natural gas. Great location on a quiet street with easy access to everything. Commuting, Train, Restaurants, Shopping, Movies, Town Green, Concerts, and Farmer's Market! Don't miss this one!
